DynamicIndicators.formula: ( "ELY_PEM.CAPEX"  + "Wind_farm.CAPEX"  ) / ( "Elec_Grid.Levelized Grid extraction ElectricalEnergy GridFlow"  + "Wind_farm.Levelized ImposedProfile ElectricalEnergy SourceLoadFlow"  + "Elec_Grid_Inject.Levelized Grid injection ElectricalEnergy GridFlow" )
DynamicIndicators.name: Elec_cost

DynamicIndicators.formula: ("ELY_PEM.CAPEX"  - "ELY_PEM.Annual consumption of ElectricalEnergy UsedPower"  * "Elec_cost" + "H2_Tank.CAPEX" ) / "ELY_PEM.Annual production of FluidH2Mass H2MassFlowRate"
DynamicIndicators.name: LCOH
